name: character-studio
description: Adapt image references using robot-base or custom Blender character workflows, transfer and test animation, and export GLB assets.

interface.shortDescription: Create stylized low-poly characters in Blender
interface.longDescription: Choose robot-base or custom character creation from a reference, with rough difficulty estimates and animation checks on the adapted character. Includes a robot with Idle/Walk/Run/Jump/Roll, a fox/dog/cat starter, Blender effect previews, and Three.js VFX helpers.
defaultPrompt: Use Character Studio to design and build a stylized low-poly 3D character in Blender.
